author: Retro Game Corps
description:
MSI has finally released their Claw A8 in North America, and it features the AMD Ryzen Z2E chipset.  Let's see how it stands apart from its competitors.

Buy one here: https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/09kxqP
More info: https://us.msi.com/Handheld/Claw-A8-BZ2EMX

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
